messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem -> need to lock owners/timelines for the GPU capacity/autoscale remediation items. Can we do a rapid check-in?

sophia: yep. I can take scheduler tuning (priority queues + preemption knobs). Planning a short experiment next week. timeline: draft config by Tue, run 48h tests Wed-Thu.

mohit: I can own quota changes with infra finance. Need to confirm headroom targets first. Proposed headroom = 18% overall; open to discussion.

carla: assigning tasks in the tracker now: https://go.redwood/incident-1993 (spreadsheet with owners + runbooks). Put any infra CI links there.

alex: thanks. mohit, can you confirm by EOD whether quota can shift by instance family or must be org-level?

mohit: short answer: we can scope per instance family, but reserved capacity booking is monthly — so need a business approval for > 10% bump. I'll ping finance.

ryan: ops-bot created a checklist item for canary rollback and emergency drain. ops-bot: task created -> ID #INC-1993-06, owner=ryan, due=2026-04-10.

ops-bot: [automated] Created task INC-1993-06: Canary drain and emergency fallback validation. Assigned to ryan. Due 2026-04-10.

carla: alex — do we want a scheduled recurrence to validate headroom weekly for next quarter? we can add an alert if tail utilization crosses 75% for 3 consecutive hours.

alex: yes please. make it weekly first, then reassess after two runs. Add alert thresholds and runbook links.

sophia: quick note on scheduler tuning experiments: starting config diff below. Will post results to the tracker.

```
# scheduler tweak (kube-scheduler config snippet)
preemption: true
priorityClasses:
  - name: realtime
    value: 100000
  - name: bulk
    value: 1000
batchWindowMs: 10
maxPreemptionsPerCycle: 2
```

carla: logging the experiment plan: export test workload (replicas=200, seq_len=1024) and simulate spike at t+24h. If tail latency increases > 20% we'll revert.

mohit: regarding headroom simulation — I can run a synthetic demand replay against the autoscaler. Need credentialed test cluster though. Who can provision?

ryan: I can spin up a one-off test cluster in staging with matching GPU families. ETA 6h. Will post kubeconfig in tracker (secure link).

alex: ownership summary: sophia=scheduler tuning (config + test), mohit=quota + finance coord, ryan=canary/fallback + test cluster, carla=tracker + alerts. deadlines: sophia Tue config, tests Wed-Thu, mohit confirm EOD, ryan cluster in 6h, carla add weekly recurrence.

carla: added weekly recurrence + alert rule in PagerDuty (rule id PD-957). Also added a dashboard panel for tail usage by zone.

mohit: finance ok to provision temporary bump for test; formal commit after we have 2 successful runs and cost projection.

alex: good. small follow-ups: 1) sophia - add perf thresholds to tracker; 2) mohit - capture cost delta; 3) ryan - validate drain procedure in canary; 4) carla - set up rolling reminders. Any objections?

sophia: none from me. :thumbsup:

mohit: looks good. will update tracker tonight.

ryan: will run the drain validation during the canary and post logs.

carla: tagging the postmortem link in tracker and marking this thread as the remediation sync.

alex: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene Fri 10:00 for a short status if we have results. Otherwise async updates in the tracker.

ops-bot: [automated reminder] Meeting scheduled: Remediation follow-up — 2026-04-03 10:00 UTC. Channel: #incidents. Reminder set for 15m before.
